newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.30 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday on balanced supply and demand of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open unchanged on Wednesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 3.2 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
